name: ceh-usability-audit
description: CEH usability audit: measure whether a non-expert can actually use what you built — cold zero-context walkthroughs by persona-constrained subagents that report where they stalled, a five-question interface audit across web UI/CLI/library/app surfaces, a three-part rewrite pass over every user-reachable error message, and a plain-language pass over labels and copy. Findings are ranked by observed outcome, not by how bad they look.
